LESSON: READING 9.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: DESCRIPTIVE FICTIONAL OR NON-FICTIONAL TEXTS (ABOUT 400 WORDS)

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.2: Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts (about 400 words)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts (about 400 words), part of Strand 9 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do you describe things? 2. How can you tell what will happen in a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. make connections between events in the text and their experiences,

2. retell the story collaboratively with peers,

3. use illustrations, the introduction and the title of a text to make predictions,

4. describe the characters, episodes and places collaboratively in a text,

5. scan a text for specific details,

6. answer questions from a text,

7. state the main ideas from a text,

8. watch a video related to the theme and pick specific information. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. make connections between events in the text and their experiences,
2. retell the story collaboratively with peers,
3. use illustrations, the introduction and the title of a text to make predictions,
4. describe the characters, episodes and places collaboratively in a text,
5. scan a text for specific details,
6. answer questions from a text,
7. state the main ideas from a text,
8. watch a video related to the theme and pick specific information. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts (about 400 words) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn is enhanced as the learner scans a text for information.

• Digital Literacy is enhanced as the learner watches a video related to the theme to pick out specific information.

Values:
Responsibility is developed as the learner reads texts which feature these values and watches a video related to the

theme.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Health Education is enhanced as the learner is exposed to information on communicable diseases.

• Environmental Education is developed as the learner reads texts about diseases.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can apply the knowledge obtained from reading texts on communicable diseases to other learning areas like

Physical and Health Education.
